response.rationale: The item is apparel, not final sale, delivered 7 days ago, so RET-007 (eligible) and RET-050 goodwill grant (eligible) apply. However, both RET-050 and RET-051 are priority 50 and conflict. RET-051 applies because fraud_hold == True, blocking returns pending review. Among the applicable rules, the fraud hold and goodwill grant tie at priority 50; the fraud hold controls the outcome as a blocking condition (returns not permitted pending review), rendering the item ineligible.
